entries.title: Psalms 67:1
segments: To the Chief Musician. On stringed instruments. A Psalm. A Song. May God be merciful to us, and bless us, and cause His face to shine on us. Selah.

entries.title: Psalms 67:2
segments: So that Your way may be known on earth, Your salvation among all nations.

entries.title: Psalms 67:3
segments: Let the peoples praise You, O God; let all the peoples thank You.

entries.title: Psalms 67:4
segments: O let the nations be glad and sing for joy; for You shall judge the peoples righteously and govern the nations on earth. Selah.

entries.title: Psalms 67:5
segments: Let the peoples give thanks to You, O God; let all the peoples praise You.

entries.title: Psalms 67:6
segments: The earth shall yield its increase; [and] God, our own God, shall bless us.

entries.title: Psalms 67:7
segments: God shall bless us; and all the ends of the earth shall fear Him.
